name: Securities Account Status 2
definition: Status of the securities account processed in the system.

RelatedSecuritiesAccount.name: Related Securities Account
RelatedSecuritiesAccount.definition: Unique identification of the securities account referenced by a request.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the securities account maintenance instruction.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Reason for the status of a securities account maintenance instruction.

StatusReasonRule.definition: If Status equals REJT (Rejected) then StatusReason must be present.

PresenceRule.definition: If Status equals COMP (Completed) then RelatedSecuritiesAccount must be present.
